gen-dafont-walkway-fs-sentient: Sentient, a serif, pinches its curves almost shut. Walkway runs the other way, its broad hooked c and tightly packed letters feeling light and open, while Sentient's gently tapering strokes carry the weight of sophistication in the text.
gen-dafont-znikomit-fs-bespoke-serif: Minimal in spirit, Znikomit rounds off every curve with wide-set terminals, and it earns its keep big and brief. Bespoke Serif then brings thin strokes near half the weight of its thick ones, giving the text a dignified, authoritative grain.
gen-dm-serif-display-gf-lexend-peta: Hairline upstrokes nearly vanish beside the heavy downstrokes of DM Serif Display, giving every word a dramatic, brush-like swing. Lexend Peta reads smoothly, marker-like and tall.
gen-dm-serif-display-gf-lexend-tera: Fat strokes, ghostly joins: DM Serif Display looks like ink pressed hard then lifted. And Lexend Tera answers with plotter-pen lines of constant width, its rounded letters standing apart like stepping stones.
gen-dm-serif-display-gf-lexend-zetta: DM Serif Display swings from bold downstrokes to hairline curves, giving a dignified, authoritative voice. And Lexend Zetta, a sans, lays down ribbon-smooth lines with tall small letters and wide tracking, so the two feel clearly different yet cooperative.
gen-dm-serif-display-gf-montserrat-alter: Montserrat Alternates reads contemporary, its open paperclip c and tall chalkboard lowercase crowding toward the capital line like bent tubing. DM Serif Display sits over it, fat and fine.
gen-dm-serif-text-gf-cascadia-mono: Bookish and editorial, DM Serif Text pairs heavy stems with thread-thin arms. Cascadia Mono spaces its letters like pins in a board, with curves as thick as its stems, so a longer stretch reads steady and compact.
gen-dm-serif-text-gf-julius-sans-one: DM Serif Text sets bold verticals against whisper-thin horizontals, giving it a bookish, editorial look. But Julius Sans One, a sans, leaves wide gaps between letters and keeps its diagonals as heavy as its verticals.
gen-dm-serif-text-gf-lexend-exa: Heavy stems and thread-thin arms make each DM Serif Text letter look freshly sliced with a blade. Lexend Exa answers with identical bar thickness, wide curves and stubby ascenders.
gen-dm-serif-text-gf-lexend-giga: DM Serif Text trades heavy stems for thread-thin arms. Lexend Giga, a sans-serif, runs flat single-weight lines with generous tracking and low ascenders, so a long passage moves along in a steady, open rhythm.
